title: Gentleness accompanies a familiar form ending
meaning: Considerate actions and a similar motive can accompany an emotional farewell to a familiar form of shared experience.
text: In this Energy Field, Strength in the physical position describes considerate handling of a powerful impulse within shared action. In energy, the same Strength motivates gentleness where it would be easy to apply pressure. Death in emotions adds the experience of an earlier phase ending. The overall tone therefore need not feel carefree: you may act very gently and want that kind of treatment, while emotionally experiencing the close of a form that has long belonged to your shared life.

For example, you close a garden plot for the final season before handing it over. There is an urge to clear everything quickly, but you avoid rushing each other over keepsakes and calmly decide what to take. **We are bringing this activity to an end with care, although gentleness does not make farewell simple.** Sadness concerns a particular place and phase, without cancelling the involvement that remains present in your shared actions. A difficult feeling can exist alongside considerate cooperation.

A difficulty appears if gentleness becomes a requirement to experience every ending gracefully and calmly. Irritation or tears then seem to violate your shared way of being together. Strength’s two roles require no doubled composure and do not remove different responses. Death in emotions does not predict the end of the union. Considerate action need not immediately give an ending a light or inspiring meaning.
